en.name: Stack CRM
en.tag: Office stack · CRM · documents · data plane
en.lead: Pipeline, accounts, contacts, tasks, and document originals on your OnlyOffice / Postgres plane — plus a file data plane (S3, SMB, SSH) so desks, agents, and backups share one corpus without SaaS egress.
replaces: Google Drive / Dropbox for ops files
en.overview: Stack CRM is the structured office system of record for sovereign installs: deals and contacts live next to document originals in OnlyOffice. Underneath sits a data plane you control — S3-compatible object storage (MinIO) for docs, media, and backups; SMB for Windows/desktop mounts; SSH/SFTP for ops sync and air-gapped drop zones. Same IdP and observability plane as Chat and Meet — adding modules later is wiring, not a re-platform.

S3-compatible object storage (MinIO) for originals, attachments, and backups
SMB shares for desktop workflows against the same corpora
SSH / SFTP paths for agent drop zones and controlled file transfer
Custom fields, stages, roles; REST + GraphQL; SSO / IdP
Webhooks on deal and contact state changes
Air-gap capable — no mandatory cloud phone-home

Teams that mount the same project files via SMB while CRM holds pipeline state
Ops that push dumps and agent artifacts over SSH/SFTP into MinIO without public cloud
Operators replacing HubSpot/Salesforce while keeping historical deals and document trees

en.name: Stack Chat
en.lead: Channels, threads, DMs, voice notes, and file sharing — end-to-end encrypted with keys you hold. Native agent bots with long-term memory, STT/TTS, and optional call join — still on your homeserver.
en.overview: Stack Chat is the collaboration spine of the suite. Search, files, and presence stay on infrastructure you control. Beyond human rooms, the same Matrix plane hosts knowledge bots that act as agents: they hear text or voice, retrieve durable context via GraphRAG (Neo4j associations + Qdrant vectors), answer with a local LLM, and can reply as text or TTS — with the room timeline as the audit trail. Positive feedback can be written back into long-term memory. Native clients cover desk and mobile so field and office share one secure plane.
features: E2E encryption with on-prem key custody
Full search index with no SaaS backhaul
Native iOS / Android / desktop clients
Channels, threads, DMs, voice notes, file sharing

Voice turns: STT (Faster-Whisper / Vosk) → RAG → local LLM → optional TTS (Piper / Coqui)
Optional Element Call / LiveKit join for voice agents; feedback loop refines the knowledge store
Air-gap deployment path for closed networks
Same identity model as CRM and Meet
useCases: Regulated orgs that forbid Slack/Teams cloud tenancies
Ops bridges between ward, clinic, and back-office without public chat SaaS
On-prem knowledge assistants in Element — text, voice message, or call — grounded in your Markdown KB
Incident rooms that must stay on LAN during WAN outages

en.name: Observing
en.lead: One shared observability plane for the suite: Grafana dashboards, Prometheus metrics, Loki logs, and Alertmanager routes into your chat — on metal you control, not a vendor SaaS tenancy.
en.overview: Observing is how produktor runs day-2 ops. A single Grafana is the UI; Prometheus scrapes host and container exporters; Loki holds docker and app logs; Alertmanager fans out to Matrix (or your on-prem channel). Compose labels plus an inventory of critical / lab / ignore stacks keep dashboards honest. Remote sites ship metrics and logs over SSH reverse tunnels — same plane for HQ and field hosts.

Inventory-driven tiers so labs do not page like production
SSH tunnel pattern for remote agents without opening scrape ports to the internet
Air-gap friendly — metrics stay inside your boundary

On-call that wants alerts in Matrix instead of a SaaS pager only
Multi-host installs (HQ + field) under one Prometheus / Loki plane
Acceptance environments that prove SLOs before cutover
